About Me

The person behind the code

I'm a final-year Computer Science & Engineering student at American International University–Bangladesh, with strong foundations in AI, machine learning, data analysis, and software development.

My work spans full-stack AI ecosystems, computer vision, and hybrid ML frameworks — from crop disease detection to misinformation classification. I care about building solutions that are technically sound and genuinely useful in the real world.

Outside coursework, I'm currently running three ongoing research studies in medical imaging, mental health analytics, and human–AI collaboration, alongside completing job simulations with JPMorgan Chase and Electronic Arts.

I'm seeking an entry-level or internship opportunity where I can apply my technical skills and research experience to build impactful, real-world solutions while growing as an AI-focused professional.
